newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates soar on borrowing pressure.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates soar on borrowing pressure.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates soared on Thursday amid borrowing pressure and dealers said overnight rates were likely to remain at higher levels on shortage of funds.
"The overnight market traded in the range of nine percent and 14 percent," one dealer said.
He said most of the early overnight deals were seen at nine percent but major deals were later struck at 12 percent.
The market closed at 15 percent, the dealer said. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192.
